name: Juliet
source:
A member of the White Mouse Clan serving [url=/c87444]Tsukuyomi[/url].
The youngest of the three mouse siblings, [url=/c87712]Daifuku's[/url] and [url=/c87713]Paris'[/url] younger sister.
She and [url=/c87445]Camelia[/url] help [url=/c74517]Yousga[/url] with work at the Shikinjou bathhouse.
She is a reliable person and worries about Daifuku, who is gaining weight.
